purpose: Hands-off $100-first growth autopilot with automatic protective exits, expectancy scoring, adaptive sizing, loss brakes, profit locks, correlation controls, explicit asset routing, and user-only funding.

funding.instructions: Use only cash and trading proceeds already inside the dedicated Robinhood Agentic account. Never pull money from any external account. Only the user may manually add more money.

sizing.instructions: Read current non-margin cash buying power and total Agentic-account equity on every run. Apply hard floor, capital ladder, portfolio guard, circuit breakers, profit lock, trade-frequency guard, and correlation guard before the smaller Teststock allocation/risk limit. Never initiate funding.

hardAccountFloor.instructions: If live Agentic-account equity is below $75, do not open any new position. Manage and close existing positions only. Do not add money automatically. Normal new-trade eligibility may resume only after live equity is at least $80 and every other guard passes.

capitalLadder.basis: Current dedicated Robinhood Agentic-account equity. Manual user deposits are allowed; the agent may never initiate them.
capitalLadder.instructions: Select the current equity tier exactly as published. Apply its stock allocation multiplier, max deployed percentage and planned-stop-risk cap. Options are disabled in the live Teststock architecture; crypto uses its own tournament and direct Robinhood Crypto API risk limits.

profitLock.instructions: Before a new trade, estimate total planned stop-loss across all open Teststock positions plus the proposed trade. Do not intentionally size a new trade so that equity minus total planned stop-loss falls below the active protected floor. Floors reduce planned risk but cannot prevent gaps or slippage.

circuitBreakers.instructions: If live Robinhood account history exposes reliable day P&L and 7-day high-water/equity data, open no new positions when current-day loss is 3% or more or 7-day drawdown is 6% or more. Continue managing exits. If the needed history is unavailable, do not invent it; fall back to capitalLadder and outcomeGuard.

tradeFrequencyGuard.instructions: Apply the published total-position and crypto frequency ceilings as risk limits, never trade quotas. Options are disabled. Protective exits never count as new entries.

correlationGuard.instructions: Avoid stacking highly correlated bets. Do not open more than one new position from the same listed risk cluster at a time. If live sector/correlation information shows two unlisted positions are effectively the same bet, treat them as one cluster. Existing exposure should make new correlated entries smaller or ineligible.

executionQuality.instructions: Prefer limit orders when supported. Never pay above a saved maximum entry. Stocks must respect the stock spread cap; crypto must respect the crypto spread cap. A missed trade is better than a bad fill.

gapRiskGuard.instructions: Use reliable prior close and current regular-session open when available. Skip or wait for revalidation if the absolute opening gap exceeds 4% or consumes more than 50% of planned entry-to-stop distance. Never widen a stop for a gap.

liquidityRanking.instructions: When multiple otherwise-qualified candidates exist, prefer tighter live spread, higher reliable dollar volume, and cleaner historical fills. A missed trade is better than poor liquidity.

exitAutomation.stockProtection: Determine the live stock quantity. For whole-share quantity, create and verify a broker-resident persistent protective stop when Robinhood accepts it. Do not retry unsupported trigger orders for a fractional remainder. Fractional quantity may use only signal.fractionalProtectionPolicy synthetic monitoring, and only while its monitoring/risk requirements pass.
exitAutomation.cryptoProtection: If crypto execution becomes supported by the connected Robinhood tools, place the strongest supported persistent protective exit at or near the Teststock invalidation immediately after entry.
exitAutomation.noProtectionNoEntry: New stock entries require the strongest supported verified protection under the current stock/fractional policy. Crypto entries use the direct Robinhood Crypto API protection path. Options are disabled.
exitAutomation.target1: At target1, sell about 25% of the ORIGINAL position when practical, then protect the remaining quantity at breakeven or tighter without widening risk.
exitAutomation.target2: At target2, use runnerContinuationPolicy. Sell enough of the ORIGINAL position to leave at most the authorized runner: normally 50% at target2 for a strong 25% runner, 60% for a moderate 15% runner, or all remaining 75% if no runner is authorized.
exitAutomation.bracketCaution: Do not assume bracket/OCO support. If the broker/tool does not support linked bracket orders, sequence protective-order changes and profit-taking carefully and verify quantities after every fill.
exitAutomation.runner: Never keep a runner solely because the original plan wanted one. It must be re-authorized by a fresh current Teststock continuation signal and remain under verified tightened protection.

healthGuard.instructions: If Teststock is stale, Robinhood tools are unavailable, order status is unknown, a protective order cannot be verified, account equity/buying power is missing, or an unexpected partial fill/duplicate appears, open no new positions. Resolve or safely manage existing exposure first. Never guess an order filled or a stop exists.

portfolioGuard.instructions: Target up to four concurrent independently qualified Teststock stock positions, ranked best-first. Each must independently pass every gate and the combined portfolio must stay within the smallest deployed-cash, planned-stop-risk, correlation, event, execution, and protection caps. If fewer than four qualify, hold the remainder in cash rather than forcing a weaker trade.

assetClassRouting.STOCK: Use only the current Teststock stock tournament winner and already-qualified stock fallbacks. Claude performs final Robinhood verification before an approved stock order.
assetClassRouting.CRYPTO: Use only the current Teststock crypto tournament qualified champion and already-qualified crypto fallbacks. The direct Robinhood Crypto API performs live quote/account/order verification and execution.

hardRules: FUNDING LOCK: never initiate a deposit, ACH transfer, debit-card transfer, bank transfer, wire, internal transfer, or any other movement of money into the Robinhood Agentic account.
Only the user may manually add capital. Trading profits may remain and be reused inside the Agentic account.
Never access, withdraw from, charge, or borrow against any external bank, card, credit line, retirement account, or other financial account.

HARD ACCOUNT FLOOR: below $75 live Agentic-account equity, manage exits only and open no new trades. Do not auto-fund. Resume new-trade eligibility only at $80 or more and only if all other guards pass.
CAPITAL TIER BOUNDARIES: >=0/<80 RECOVERY; >=80/<100 DEFENSE; >=100/<125 PROVE; >=125/<150 SCALE; >=150 GROWTH. Exactly $100 is PROVE. Never select the lower tier at an exact boundary.
Apply capitalLadder, profitLock, circuitBreakers, tradeFrequencyGuard, correlationGuard, executionQuality, exitAutomation, healthGuard, portfolioGuard, and outcomeGuard before every new position.
A stock must pass Teststock expectancy, adaptive-performance, historical sample, reward/risk, market/sector/intraday, freshness, and entry gates. Never loosen a failed gate to force a trade.

For stocks use the smallest amount allowed by the ladder-adjusted Teststock allocation, tier planned-stop-risk cap, tier max-deployed cap, profit-lock floor, trade-frequency guard, correlation guard, and available non-margin cash.
Never add to a losing position and never move a protective exit farther away from the entry.

Before every trade verify live executable price, spread, current Agentic-account buying power/equity, existing positions, open orders, signal expiration, daily/weekly trade counts when available, and correlation with existing exposure.
Prefer limit orders when supported; never pay above maximumEntry and skip entries with excessive spread/slippage.
Do not buy below minimumEntry or above maximumEntry. If price is outside the range, wait.
Crypto may be executed only if the connected Robinhood tools explicitly expose crypto order placement at runtime; otherwise crypto remains signal-only.
Obey circuit breakers when reliable account-history data is available; circuit breakers stop new entries but do not prevent protective exits.
If Teststock, Robinhood, order status, or protective-order status materially disagree or cannot be verified, do not open a new trade.
Unused capital stays in cash. Never increase risk to chase a return target or recover losses.

Manage exits automatically: invalidation means exit/protective stop; target1 means protect gains and consider partial profit; target2 means prioritize profit capture. The user should not need to calculate stops manually.
DUAL HOLDOUT: use separate 2024-2025 and 2026+ untouched validation. A failure blocks/reduces the affected regime; sparse second-holdout evidence reduces risk.
REGIME-SPECIFIC ENTRIES: use stricter regime profiles for calm, volatile, trending-down, trending-up, mixed, and unknown environments; never loosen base probability gates.

TOP FOUR STOCK PORTFOLIO: rank stocks best-first and target up to four independently qualified stock positions. Never force a fourth position if it fails any gate; unused capacity stays cash. Up to 4 new positions/day and 12 per rolling 7 days are ceilings only, and all total-risk, cash, cluster, event, spread, protection, and circuit-breaker limits still apply.

TARGET2 QUALIFICATION: use target2 for the minimum reward/risk entry gate. Target1 is a partial-profit/de-risking milestone and must not incorrectly disqualify a setup whose full target satisfies the required asymmetry.

CONDITIONAL RUNNER: at target1 sell about 25% of the original stock position and tighten protection. At target2 leave at most a 25% runner only if a fresh current continuation signal is strong; leave 15% for moderate continuation; otherwise exit the full remainder. Any runner must remain under verified tightened protection and may never be kept on stale/missing/weak evidence.

COST-ADJUSTED EXPECTANCY: subtract the encoded conservative execution-friction allowance before stock eligibility/ranking. Never rank a nominal edge above a stronger after-cost edge merely because costs were ignored.
SYMBOL PROBATION: lightly tested symbols start at reduced size until historical and real-fill evidence improves.
GAP + LIQUIDITY: avoid large opening gaps, never widen stops for gaps, and prefer tighter spreads/higher reliable dollar volume among otherwise-equal candidates.
PIPELINE FRESHNESS: dataFreshness.lastSuccessfulGeneration and per-asset ages are machine-readable. A stale dependency fails closed; never hide a stalled generator by extending validity windows.

FRACTIONAL STOP LIMITATION: the connected Robinhood Agentic runtime has rejected triggered stop orders for fractional share quantities with Invalid trigger for fractional order. Do not repeatedly retry unsupported stop-market/stop-limit fractional orders.

FRACTIONAL SYNTHETIC PROTECTION: a new fractional stock entry is permitted only if active regular-session monitoring can be verified at intervals of 5 minutes or less and planned stop risk is capped at 0.75% of live equity. When the saved invalidation is observed as breached, submit the supported fractional market sell immediately when permitted and verify the result.

WHOLE/HYBRID PROTECTION: use a verified broker-resident stop for whole-share quantity when supported; for mixed quantities, reconcile the whole-share broker stop with the synthetic fractional remainder so combined sell orders can never exceed the live position.

SYNTHETIC STOP HONESTY: an agent-managed fractional stop is not persistent broker protection and cannot guarantee the planned exit. If monitoring becomes unavailable, do not add fractional risk and do not keep a fractional runner unattended.
LIVE ASSET SCOPE: only STOCK and CRYPTO are eligible. Options and futures are disabled.

TOURNAMENT AUTHORITY: do not invent a symbol outside the current Teststock stock or crypto tournament winner/fallback set. Robinhood live checks may reject a winner but may not substitute an unranked idea.

runtimeRegimePolicy.reason: Both untouched holdouts remained positive under the regime-specific entry profile.

bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.aTier: Existing elite regime profile; normal size.
bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.bTier: Positive-expectancy best-acceptable fallback used only when no A-tier candidate outranks it. B keeps all hard execution/protection/account guards and uses 50% candidate-size multiplier.
bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.rule: Buy the highest-ranked A candidate when one is live and valid. If no A survives, the highest-ranked B candidate may be bought at reduced size. Hold cash only when neither tier survives every live hard guard.

runtimeGapGuard.rule: At runtime compare the current session open with the prior regular-session close when reliable. Skip a new entry after an absolute opening gap above 4%, or when the gap consumes more than 50% of planned entry-to-stop distance, unless the signal explicitly revalidates after the open. Never widen the stop to accommodate a gap.

runtimeLiquidityRanking.minimumReliableDollarVolume: Prefer highly liquid names; when reliable average dollar-volume is exposed, reject clearly illiquid candidates and rank otherwise-equal candidates by tighter spread and higher dollar volume.

policy.runnerExitPolicy: 25% target1; at target2 leave 25% only on strong continuation, 15% on moderate continuation, otherwise exit all remaining

candidateQueuePolicy.rule: Try candidates in queue order. Every primary or reserve must pass all live gates and live sizing. Never weaken a gate to reach four; hold cash if all fail.

bestAcceptableEntryPolicy.executionRule: Buy the highest-ranked live A candidate when one survives every live guard. If no A survives, buy the highest-ranked live B candidate at its reduced encoded size. If the selected candidate fails before submission, keep trying eligible fallbacks in the same run. Hold cash only when no A or B survives every hard guard.

cryptoPlan.reason: No A/A+ crypto setup is currently in its allowed buy zone.

execution.note: The current Robinhood MCP connection exposes equity execution but does not expose the crypto quote/position/order tools required for safe live crypto execution.

CALM.reason: At least one untouched holdout failed a robustness gate.

VOLATILE.reason: One untouched holdout lacks enough samples; reduce risk until evidence improves.

TRENDING_DOWN.reason: One untouched holdout lacks enough samples; reduce risk until evidence improves.

TRENDING_UP.reason: Both untouched holdouts remained positive under the regime-specific entry profile.

UNKNOWN.reason: One untouched holdout lacks enough samples; reduce risk until evidence improves.

entryGateRobustness.instructions: Do not loosen gates automatically. A failed untouched regime blocks new risk; sparse second-holdout evidence reduces size. Real Robinhood fills remain the final performance evidence.
entryGateRobustness.interpretation: Development, first untouched holdout, and second untouched confirmation holdout are kept separate. Regime-specific profiles are stricter-or-equal overlays and may never loosen base gates.

summary.note: Diagnostic only. Shadow outcomes must never automatically loosen live-money gates.

probabilityFirstPolicy.objective: Increase the probability of positive compounding while keeping stocks primary, options exceptional, crypto active around the clock, and cash acceptable. Prefer elite A stocks, allow a reduced-size B best-acceptable stock when no A survives, and let crypto surface more reasonable 24/7 opportunities without removing hard risk controls. This policy cannot eliminate market loss risk.

bestAcceptable.rule: B is a reduced-size fallback, not a waiver. It must still have bullish direction, positive conservative expectancy, adequate history, acceptable R:R, bounded volatility, and every downstream live account/execution/protection guard.

stocks.instructions: Target2 is the qualification target; target1 is for partial profit/de-risking. Use cost-adjusted conservative expectancy when available so execution friction cannot be ignored. A tier always ranks before B tier.

options.instructions: An option may be considered only after the underlying clears these research and cost-adjusted gates AND Claude confirms the live Teststock real-fill evidence gate. One whole contract must still fit the active capital-tier dollar-risk cap.

crypto.instructions: Crypto runs 24/7, so the research gate is intentionally more permissive than before to surface more plausible A/A+ setups. Keep positive historical tendency, 4-hour confirmation, BTC context for altcoins, liquidity, defined stops, no leverage, no averaging down, and one-position-at-a-time controls. Broker execution availability remains a separate hard gate.

rankingPolicy.notes: A higher score is only priority among already-qualified research candidates. Claude must skip any candidate that fails live execution, broker, event, real-fill, protection, frequency, correlation, cash, or account-risk checks.

crossAssetOpportunityRanking.instructions: Use this only to prioritize among research-qualified opportunities. A higher-ranked item must still pass every live account, broker, entry, spread, gap, event, real-fill, protection, cash, correlation, frequency, and risk check. Never force a trade because it ranks first.

symbolProbationPolicy.instructions: New or lightly tested symbols start smaller. Historical sample depth and real Robinhood fills can promote a symbol; weak symbol-level real-fill performance can reduce or block it. Probation never increases risk.

dataFreshness.instructions: This block is regenerated on every successful publish attempt. If lastSuccessfulGeneration or an asset signal age exceeds its stale threshold, treat that dependency as stale and open no new position from it.

criticalDependencies: verified protective-exit capability for a new stock/option
journal reconciliation or reliable Robinhood-history reconstruction
active <=5-minute monitoring for any new fractional stock exposure
systemHealth.instructions: Any missing, stale, contradictory, or unknown critical dependency means no new position.

performanceScalingGuard.instructions: Equity alone never unlocks higher risk; confirmed real-fill evidence caps the effective risk tier.

runnerContinuationPolicy.runnerSizingRule: At target2, sell enough of the ORIGINAL position so only the currently-authorized runner remains. Strong continuation: leave 25% runner (normally sell 50% at target2 after 25% sold at target1). Moderate continuation: leave 15% runner (sell 60% at target2). Weak, missing, stale, contradictory, or blocked continuation: leave 0% runner (sell all 75% remaining at target2).

live price remains above tightened protective exit

live price remains above tightened protective exit

protection.afterTarget1: Protect the remaining position at breakeven or tighter when supported; never widen risk.
protection.afterTarget2: Any runner must have a verified tightened persistent protective exit. Tighten only; never move protection farther away. If protection cannot be verified, exit the runner.
protection.trailingMethod: Use the strongest supported trailing/tightening mechanism available from the broker/agent. Do not invent an unsupported trailing order.
protection.fractionalRunnerRule: A fractional runner requires both continuation authorization and healthy active synthetic-stop monitoring under signal.fractionalProtectionPolicy. Without that monitoring, exit the fractional runner instead of leaving it unattended.

runnerContinuationPolicy.instructions: Exit shape is constrained by exitPolicyValidation. T1_25_T2_75 is currently authorized. Missing/stale validation falls back to T1_25_T2_75 with no runner. A continuation signal may only REDUCE the authorized runner; it may never exceed the validated maximum.

observedPlatformConstraint.interpretation: The connected Robinhood Agentic order path rejected stop-market and stop-limit trigger orders for fractional share quantities. Do not keep retrying unsupported triggered fractional orders.

protectionHierarchy: For whole-share quantity, prefer a verified broker-resident persistent stop/stop-limit when the runtime accepts it.
For a mixed position, protect the whole-share portion with a broker-resident stop when supported and treat only the fractional remainder as synthetic-stop exposure.
For a position below one full share, no broker trigger may be assumed. Fractional protection is agent-managed synthetic protection only when active monitoring is healthy.
Never describe a synthetic stop as broker-resident, guaranteed, or equivalent to a persistent stop.

fractionalSyntheticStop.triggerRule: When a reliable live Robinhood price at or below the saved Teststock stop/invalidation is observed, submit a fractional market sell for the protected fractional quantity immediately when runtime permissions allow. Re-read position/order status after submission and never infer a fill.
fractionalSyntheticStop.monitoringFailureRule: If active monitoring cannot be verified during the regular session, do not open new fractional stock exposure. Existing synthetic-only fractional exposure is DEGRADED/UNPROTECTED; do not add risk. If runtime permissions allow automatic risk reduction, exit the synthetic-only fractional quantity rather than knowingly leaving it unattended.
fractionalSyntheticStop.marketClosedRule: Do not pretend an agent-managed stop can execute while monitoring/order routing is unavailable. Re-check immediately when the regular session becomes actionable. Gap/slippage can exceed the planned stop.
fractionalSyntheticStop.slippageWarning: A synthetic stop is not a resting broker order. Detection latency, outages, usage limits, gaps, fast markets, and market-order slippage can produce losses materially larger than planned.

mixedQuantity.rule: Let wholeQty=floor(live share quantity) and fractionalRemainder=live quantity-wholeQty. When supported, protect wholeQty with a broker-resident stop and protect only fractionalRemainder synthetically. Before any sell, reconcile open sell orders so combined sell quantity cannot exceed the live position.

targetManagement.target1: Fractional partial profit may use the supported fractional sell path. After target1, whole shares should retain/tighten broker protection when supported; any fractional remainder remains subject to synthetic monitoring rules.
targetManagement.target2: Apply runnerContinuationPolicy, but a fractional runner is allowed only while active monitoring satisfies this policy. If monitoring is not healthy, leave no synthetic-only fractional runner.
targetManagement.runner: A fractional runner may never survive solely because continuation is strong. Both continuation evidence AND active synthetic-stop monitoring must pass.

existingFractionalPositionResponse.firstAction: Inspect live quantity, open orders, saved Teststock stop/invalidation, current price, and runtime monitoring capability.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifStopBreached: Submit the supported fractional market sell immediately when permitted, then verify the fill/remaining quantity.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifStopNotBreachedButMonitoringHealthy: Keep the saved invalidation as a synthetic trigger, apply the reduced synthetic-risk policy to any future entries, and monitor at the required interval.
existingFractionalPositionResponse.ifMonitoringNotHealthy: Mark protection DEGRADED, open no additional fractional risk, and prefer reducing/closing synthetic-only exposure when automatic risk reduction is permitted rather than pretending it is protected.

fractionalProtectionPolicy.instructions: Fractional-share protection is a degraded fallback forced by the observed broker limitation, not an upgrade. New fractional entries are allowed only when active monitoring can enforce the saved invalidation at least every 5 minutes during the regular session and planned stop risk is no more than 0.75% of live equity. Otherwise skip the fractional entry. Whole-share broker protection remains preferred.

wholeShareTieBreaker.rule: Only after eligibility and opportunity quality are effectively tied, prefer the candidate whose live allowed allocation can purchase at least 1 whole share so broker-resident protection may be available.

fractionalOnlyFallback.note: GitHub/Alpaca detect triggers and publish a compact dispatch packet without an LLM. Detection alone is not a broker stop; a timely authorized execution run is still needed.

exitPolicyValidation.recommendationReason: The no-runner baseline was the strongest policy in development, so no runner policy is promoted.

modelSizingPolicy.instructions: Backtests, scanner history, and shadow data may rank or reduce risk but never increase live allocation.

policy.instructions: Among otherwise-qualified stocks, prefer lower-correlation combinations. One name per >=0.75 cluster may use normal eligible size; a second must be no more than half its otherwise-allowed size; a third from the same cluster is blocked. Never use correlation to increase size.

requirements: challenger selected on development data only
challenger passes or has explicitly sparse 2026+ confirmation under existing conservative rule
challenger does not materially worsen drawdown
promotionPolicy.instructions: A challenger may replace the exit shape only after the existing validation script authorizes it. It may never increase entry size, loosen a stop, bypass a safety gate, or force a trade.

triggers: fresh holdout evidence no longer supports champion

executionLearningPolicy.instructions: Use confirmed real fills to prefer cleaner execution among already-qualified candidates. Never let execution history create a trade, raise live entry risk, or override safety gates.

postTradeAttributionPolicy.instructions: After a resolved real trade, attribute what helped or hurt only when the evidence is observable. Multiple categories may apply. UNKNOWN is preferred over guessing.

setupSpecificExitResearch.instructions: Global validated exit policy remains live. Setup-specific exits may be studied in shadow and promoted only after separate untouched holdout evidence is sufficient.

liveTradeStatePolicy.instructions: Never infer live holdings from Teststock planning data. Live holdings/fills come only from Robinhood. Unknown or contradictory live state blocks new risk.

portfolioHeatPolicy.instructions: Calculate portfolio heat from live Robinhood positions plus saved Teststock invalidations. Missing live quantities/prices means UNKNOWN and blocks new entries.

signalDriftPolicy.instructions: Immediately before a buy compare live executable price with the fresh signal. Revalidate/skip when drift exceeds 1% or consumes more than 25% of the entry-to-stop distance. Never widen the stop or chase.

Robinhood balances, positions, orders or fills are contradictory/unknown

automationKillSwitch.resetRule: Only resume new entries after the triggering condition is positively verified healthy. Time passing alone does not clear the kill switch.
automationKillSwitch.instructions: Never liquidate blindly. Manage existing exits by the safest supported path and open no new positions while a critical fault remains.

smallAccountAccessPolicy.instructions: A cheaper whole-share stock may not replace a materially stronger fractional candidate merely because it is cheaper. Whole-share protectability is only a late tie-breaker between already-qualified, genuinely comparable candidates.

multiStockCompetitionPolicy.buyOptionRule: If one or more stocks have already passed every Teststock research gate and are currently inside a valid live buy zone, expose the highest-ranked one as CURRENT_BEST_BUY.
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.fallbackRule: If the current best buy fails a live Robinhood guard before order submission, evaluate the next live qualified fallback in the same Claude run. Stop after the first submitted buy.
rankingOrder: whole-share tie-breaker only for genuine near-ties
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.cashRule: If no candidate passes every applicable live gate, hold cash. Never manufacture a buy merely because the market is open.
multiStockCompetitionPolicy.instructions: Multiple stocks compete continuously. The system should preserve a visible buy option whenever at least one genuinely qualified candidate exists, without weakening any safety or quality gate.

nonLlmTriggerMonitor.creditPolicy: GitHub + Alpaca monitor market prices. Claude should not continuously poll prices.
nonLlmTriggerMonitor.instructions: This layer saves LLM credits by moving price polling out of Claude. It detects and publishes triggers; it is not itself brokerage execution.

eventDrivenExecutionDispatch.instructions: The execution runtime should fetch the tiny dispatch file first. If claudeShouldRun=false, stop immediately with no Robinhood calls or full analysis. If true, process the single highest-priority event; for a failed pre-submission buy, continue through ranked fallbackActions in the same run. Verify all live guards, execute/verify only the permitted brokerage action, reconcile state, then stop.

rounds.rule: Scan every legitimate active/tradable operating-company stock available from the connected U.S. equity universe, up to a 20,000-symbol ceiling. Never invent symbols or pad with ETFs/warrants just to hit 20,000.
Rank the entire available discovery pool by market quality, liquidity and momentum; send the best 2,000 to deeper daily-history analysis.
Require sufficient history, verified 20-day dollar liquidity, trend/setup structure and bounded volatility.
Run setup-specific historical validation and eliminate weak win-rate, sample-depth, direction, liquidity and volatility profiles.
Apply A-tier elite gates first, then a reduced-size B best-acceptable tier with positive expectancy/history/R:R floors. Hard account, price, spread, gap, correlation and protection gates never relax.

Choose live A candidates first. If no A survives, choose the strongest live B candidate at reduced size. If it fails before submission, try the next eligible fallback. Hold cash only when no A or B survives every hard guard.

stockTournament.instructions: Use every legitimate active/tradable operating-company stock available from the connected U.S. equity universe, up to 20,000 symbols. Prefer A-tier elite candidates. If no A candidate survives every live guard, buy the strongest B-tier best-acceptable candidate at its reduced encoded size. If it fails before submission, try the next eligible fallback in the same run. Never relax hard account, freshness, pricing, spread, gap, correlation or protection rules just to ensure a trade.

brokerExecution.reason: The current Robinhood MCP connection exposes equity execution but does not expose the crypto quote/position/order tools required for safe live crypto execution.
brokerExecution.rule: Continue 24/7 crypto research and ranking, but never emit an executable crypto BUY trigger or wake Claude solely for a crypto entry until the connected Robinhood runtime explicitly exposes all required crypto execution tools.

cryptoTournament.instructions: Crypto continues to run its 24/7 research tournament, but the current Claude/Robinhood connection cannot safely execute crypto. Do not emit an executable crypto buy or wake Claude solely for a crypto entry until live quote, position, and order-placement tools are explicitly available at runtime.

stock.purpose: Research and rank stock contenders until the best currently qualified setup survives, with already-qualified fallbacks retained.
stock.execution: Claude uses Robinhood only for final broker-side verification of the Teststock winner/fallback: price, buying power, positions/orders, spread, account/risk/protection guards, then requests the required user approval and executes when permitted.
stock.selectorRule: Do not invent a different stock. Start with Teststock liveBuyChampion/current best qualified stock; if it fails a live Robinhood guard, try the next already-qualified Teststock fallback in order.

crypto.purpose: Continuously research and rank supported crypto pairs using trend, confirmation, history, liquidity, BTC context and risk checks until the best qualified setup survives.
crypto.execution: The direct Robinhood Crypto API lane uses the Teststock crypto winner/fallback and Robinhood live quote/account/order state for final execution checks. Claude is not required for overnight crypto execution.
crypto.selectorRule: Do not invent a different crypto asset. Use the Teststock qualified crypto champion or an already-qualified fallback only.

executionArchitecture.rule: Teststock decides what is worth considering through two independent tournaments. Robinhood is the live execution truth. Broker-side checks may reject a tournament winner but may never replace it with an unranked idea or weaken Teststock gates.
